description: MapMyCrop is a two-stage system for smart crop monitoring. The first stage is a deep learning model using 1D CNN that estimates sown area and crop yield from satellite-derived time series indices. The second stage is a Java-based tool that integrates these predictions for user-friendly visualization, reporting, and further analysis.

output_data.post_processing: Predictions are passed to a Java-based estimator that integrates yield with acreage to generate spatial yield maps and region-wise summaries.

training.training_data_size: n field samples from Study Site

limitations: Performance may vary under high cloud contamination or mixed cropping systems.
Limited size of imagery in terms of processing due to pixel-wise computation (width x height x channel)
Java tool currently supports only specific crop types and may require updating region-level parameters manually.

dataset.name: Ground-truth crop yield and acreage data from [Your Study Region]

deployment.integration: Java-based desktop application with GUI for spatial yield estimation and report generation
